latest_release.body:
Windows only. Both packages are built from `3203c39` on `main`. Installation and troubleshooting: see `README.md` inside each package.

## What's Changed

- **Edge0 145B and Edge0 120B.** Two latent-MoE models for a single NVIDIA GPU, run by edge0-strata.
- **New inference engine, edge0-infer.** A single on-device MoE engine in C++ on GGML, with one native API, replaces the Python framework and the four separate platform apps. It includes a CLI (`run`, `chat`, `bench`, `serve`, `info`), an OpenAI-compatible local server and the Edge0 Chat desktop app. This release supports Edge0 35B; Edge0 8B follows in a later release. 
- **Anthropic Messages API.** The local server also answers `POST /v1/messages` and `POST /v1/messages/count_tokens` for native models, and LAN authentication accepts `x-api-key`. (#180)

## Windows x64

`edge0-chat-0.2.0-windows-x64.zip`

- Edge0 35B runs on the CPU (AVX2) or on a GPU through Vulkan.
- Edge0 145B and Edge0 120B run on an NVIDIA GPU (CUDA) of compute capability 7.5 or newer (RTX 20 / 30 / 40 / 50) with at least 16 GiB of GPU memory, 20 GiB of system memory, and the NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit 13 installed.

SHA256: `c7146b76d51c7986723b81a3643893e1ccbb09ce4f365a5090dc99e476bb31b9`

## Windows Arm64

`edge0-chat-0.2.0-windows-arm64.zip`

- Edge0 35B runs on the CPU or on a GPU through Vulkan.
- Edge0 145B and Edge0 120B run on an NVIDIA GPU (CUDA) of compute capability 12.1, such as the NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X, with at least 16 GiB of GPU memory, 20 GiB of system memory, and the NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit 13 for Windows Arm64 installed. The CUDA code is built for `sm_121` only.

SHA256: `f64accb2c963058bc4ff1c9b064ccb35dc62ccdf8881b9a797d1ddab136f500a`

## Models

Model weights are not included in the packages.

- Edge0 145B: [Edge0-145B-NVFP4](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-145B-NVFP4), [Edge0-145B-q3k](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-145B-q3k)
- Edge0 120B: [Edge0-120B-NVFP4](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-120B-NVFP4), [Edge0-120B-q3k](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-120B-q3k)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0/compare/v0.1.1...v0.2.0

## News

More updates

Full release notes - **[2026-11-13]** We released **`edge0-145b`** and **`edge0-120b`**, latent mixture-of-experts models derived from Qwen3.8-Flash-Next for a single NVIDIA GPU on Linux or Windows. They run on [edge0-strata](edge0-strata/EDGE0.md), which `edge0-infer serve` and `edge0-infer chat` start for them; see the [model page](docs/models/edge0-145b.md). Weights on Hugging Face: [`Edge0-145B-q3k`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-145B-q3k) · [`Edge0-145B-NVFP4`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-145B-NVFP4) · [`Edge0-120B-q3k`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-120B-q3k) · [`Edge0-120B-NVFP4`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-120B-NVFP4). - **[2026-11-04]** We released the **unified inference engine [`edge0-infer`](edge0-infer/README.md)**: built on [GGML](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml), one engine and one native C++ API run the same model on macOS, iOS, Android and Windows, with a CLI, an OpenAI-compatible local server, and chat app examples for desktop, Android and iOS. The first release supports `edge0-35b`; `edge0-8b` follows in a later release. It replaces the Python framework and the per-platform engines; the previous code is kept at tag [`pre-edge0-infer`](https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0/tree/pre-edge0-infer). - **[2026-09-30]** We released the **edge0 inference engines for four platforms — iOS, macOS, Android and Windows** (source at tag [`pre-edge0-infer`](https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0/tree/pre-edge0-infer)). - **[2026-09-16]** Our technical report is on arXiv: [The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18063). - **[2026-09-08]** Initial open-source release of **edge0**, together with both model tiers — [`Edge0-35B-A3B-preview`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview) and [`Edge0-8B-A1B-preview`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-8B-A1B-preview) — on Hugging Face and ModelScope.

Previous release

 → [35B / 8B release guide](docs/legacy-models.md) — model downloads, architecture, benchmarks, supported platforms and setup instructions.
## About

Edge0 is an open-source streaming MoE inference framework for running large sparse models on consumer hardware.

Use it through the command line, a local API server, or the Edge0 Chat app. The latest release brings 145B and 120B latent-MoE models to a single NVIDIA GPU. Trained natively at 4 bits, both models are available in Q3_K and NVFP4 for local agent workloads. [`edge0-infer`](edge0-infer/README.md) provides shared `serve` and `chat` commands and selects the engine from the model folder. The latest models run on [edge0-strata](edge0-strata/EDGE0.md), a fork of Strata; the previous 35B release runs on the [GGML-based native engine](docs/legacy-models.md#native-engine-design). ### Platforms Support depends on the model and its engine. | Platform | `edge0-145b`, `edge0-120b` (edge0-strata) | `edge0-35b` (native engine) | | --- | --- | --- | | **Linux** | NVIDIA GPU (CUDA 13) | CPU | | **Windows** | NVIDIA GPU (CUDA 13) | CPU, Vulkan | | **macOS** (Apple Silicon) | — | Metal, CPU | | **iOS** | — | Metal | | **Android** | — | CPU | Use the [145B / 120B setup](#getting-started) for the latest release. The [previous-release guide](docs/legacy-models.md#platforms) covers native backends, platform-specific builds and chat examples. The 8B checkpoint is available; native-engine support is planned. ## Models

145B / 120B are the current latent-MoE series, derived from Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and trained natively at 4 bits.

They run on edge0-strata through `edge0-infer serve` and `edge0-infer chat`, on Linux or Windows with an NVIDIA GPU and CUDA 13. **145B Q3_K · RTX 5090 D 24 GB:** 121.2 tok/s agent decode · 3554.9 tok/s 16K prefill. | Tier | Released checkpoint | Inference profile | Engine | |---|---|---|---| | [`edge0-145b`](docs/models/edge0-145b.md) | [`Edge0/Edge0-145B-q3k`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-145B-q3k) · [NVFP4](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-145B-NVFP4) | Q3_K or NVFP4 latent experts (1792), 48 layers, 512 experts, K=10 | edge0-strata ✅ (Linux or Windows, NVIDIA GPU) | | [`edge0-120b`](docs/models/edge0-145b.md) | [`Edge0/Edge0-120B-q3k`](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-120B-q3k) · [NVFP4](https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Edge0-120B-NVFP4) | Q3_K or NVFP4 latent experts (1280), 48 layers, 512 experts, K=10 | edge0-strata ✅ (Linux or Windows, NVIDIA GPU) |

Model overview · 145B Q3_K

## Quality ### 145B / 120B Six benchmarks, six models. Higher is better. Scores are reported by model, not as separate Q3_K and NVFP4 evaluations. [Copyable scores and all model names](docs/models/edge0-145b.md#quality)
Copyable scores · all six models Bold values indicate the best score in each column. | Model | deepswe 1.1 | terminal-bench 2.1 | AA-LCR | IFBench | GPQA-Diamond | HLE | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | | **Edge0-145B** | **64.6** | **86.5** | 79.3 | 80.6 | 90.4 | 35.4 | | **Edge0-120B** | 51.3 | 75.3 | 81.0 | 79.3 | 87.4 | 31.0 | | DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 | 54.4 | 82.7 | 79.7 | 79.2 | 90.8 | 33.8 | | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | 58.7 | 83.3 | 79.1 | **81.3** | **91.7** | 35.9 | | Qwen3.8-27B | 42.2 | 73.0 | **82.0** | 79.5 | 89.2 | 30.8 | | Claude-Opus-4.6 (Max) | / | 78.2 | 78.0 | 62.5 | 91.3 | **40.0** |
## Benchmark ### 145B / 120B All throughput figures are in tok/s. The headline uses **145B Q3_K** on RTX 5090 D 24 GB.
145B speed table · all machines and builds Highlighted rows show Q3_K. Click the table to view it at full size.
Copyable 145B speed data | Machine | Build | 4K prefill | 16K prefill | Chat decode | Agent decode | |---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | RTX 5090 D 24 GB | Q3_K | 2169.9 | 3554.9 | 99.7 | **121.2** | | RTX 5090 D 24 GB | NVFP4 | 1839.6 | 3165.7 | 79.6 | 98.3 | | RTX 4090 24 GB | Q3_K | 2042.0 | 3179.4 | 69.9 | 91.7 | | RTX Spark N1X 60 GiB | Q3_K | 674.0 | 770.3 | 37.7 | 36.7 | | RTX Spark N1X 60 GiB | NVFP4 | 821.2 | 922.4 | 40.1 | 46.0 | | Apple M2 Ultra (Metal) | Q3_K | 755.6 | 800.3 | 60.9 | 57.0 | | 16 GiB VRAM + 20 GiB RAM | Q3_K | 249 | 335 | 36.8 | 44.9 |
145B measurement conditions · constrained budget and memory residency The `16 GiB VRAM + 20 GiB RAM` rows are the same RTX 5090 D 24 GB, not a different card. VRAM is capped with `--vram-reserve-mib 8192`; system RAM by a cgroup (`MemoryMax=20G`, no swap). With residency on, the same card holds **Q3_K** (40.81 GiB of weights) as 23.14 GiB VRAM + 31.28 GiB RAM, and **NVFP4** (47.79 GiB) as 23.25 GiB VRAM + 38.27 GiB RAM — disjoint expert sets, nothing counted twice. See [Usage & troubleshooting](#usage-help) for memory-saving options. The 16 GiB VRAM + 20 GiB RAM budget is a test limit, not a minimum system requirement. The Apple M2 Ultra row is a Metal measurement, not an announcement of macOS release availability.
120B speed table · all machines and builds
Copyable 120B speed data | Machine | Build | 4K prefill | 16K prefill | Chat decode | Agent decode | |---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | RTX 5090 D 24 GB | Q3_K | 3236.7 | 4576.5 | 130.2 | **144.6** | | RTX 5090 D 24 GB | NVFP4 | 2668.5 | 4357.1 | 124.9 | 135.5 | | RTX 4090 24 GB | Q3_K | 2637.5 | 3551.1 | 95.0 | 104.9 | | RTX Spark N1X 60 GiB | Q3_K | 987.0 | 1081.7 | 47.2 | 68.4 | | RTX Spark N1X 60 GiB | NVFP4 | 996.4 | 1066.9 | 45.1 | 68.9 | | Apple M2 Ultra (Metal) | Q3_K | 867.6 | 908.7 | 60.4 | 63.0 | | 16 GiB VRAM + 20 GiB RAM | Q3_K | 430 | 778 | 62.4 | 73.3 | | 16 GiB VRAM + 20 GiB RAM | NVFP4 | 361.1 | 619.7 | 51.3 | 59.9 |
`16 GiB VRAM + 20 GiB RAM` rows are the RTX 5090 D 24 GB again, constrained by cgroup to a 16 GiB VRAM and 20 GiB system-RAM budget — not a different card. With residency on, the same card holds **Q3_K** (27.98 GiB of weights) as 22.93 GiB VRAM + 18.40 GiB RAM, and **NVFP4** (32.96 GiB) as 23.02 GiB VRAM + 23.40 GiB RAM — disjoint expert sets, nothing counted twice. These residency readings use expert residency enabled, `--no-prefill-borrow`, conv cache = 0 and kv-resident = 0. Host RAM is measured as `RssAnon + RssShmem`. These are single-run readings, not minimum system requirements. See [Usage & troubleshooting](#usage-help) for memory-saving options.

In action

Five demonstrations · chapter guide | Time | Demonstration | | --- | --- | | 0:00 | Local Chat & Coding | | 0:36 | Video Production | | 0:58 | Manhattan in 3D | | 1:19 | Cathedral World Building | | 1:38 | PCB Design | [Chapter markers (VTT)](assets/edge0-release/showcase-chapters.vtt)
## Architecture Latent MoE compresses expert inputs while keeping attention at full width. The 145B model uses latent width 1792; the 120B model uses 1280. Both route each token to 10 of 512 experts, alongside one shared expert.
Architecture details · diagram and configuration [Full configuration, routing and both model profiles](docs/models/edge0-145b.md#model-profile).
## Getting Started ### 145B / 120B · edge0-strata Each model folder (Q3_K or NVFP4, Edge0-145B or Edge0-120B) runs through `edge0-infer`, from the command line or from the Edge0 Chat desktop app. Keep the folder as it is: `edge0-infer` identifies the model by `model_name` in its `model.json`. For 145B and 120B, use `serve` or `chat`; `run` belongs to the native engine.
Platform & documentation notes The build instructions target NVIDIA GPUs with CUDA 13 on Linux or Windows (x64 or ARM64). The Apple M2 Ultra measurements use Metal; they do not establish macOS release availability.
Build & command-line instructions **1. Build.** Clone the repository, then build two parts. Run the launch commands below from `edge0-infer/`: ```bash git clone https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0.git edge0 ``` - **edge0-strata**, the engine: follow "Build (Linux, NVIDIA)" or "Build (Windows, NVIDIA)" in [edge0-strata/EDGE0.md](edge0-strata/EDGE0.md). - **edge0-infer**: follow "Build" (Linux) or "Windows" in [edge0-infer/docs/getting-started.md](edge0-infer/docs/getting-started.md). **2. Run from the command line.** Pass one model folder, such as `Edge0-145B-q3k`, not the folder that holds several of them. On Windows the program is `build\windows\bin\edge0-infer.exe`. ```bash build/cpu/bin/edge0-infer serve --model /path/to/Edge0-145B-q3k ``` It prints `Listening: http://127.0.0.1:8000 model=` once the weights are loaded, where `` is `edge0_145b`, and then serves OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints: ```bash curl localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"model":"edge0_145b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":64}' ``` `edge0-infer chat --model /path/to/Edge0-145B-q3k` opens an interactive session instead. More options: [edge0-infer/docs/edge0-145b.md](edge0-infer/docs/edge0-145b.md).
Desktop app · Windows ⬇️ **Download:** **[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0/releases)** Open **Edge0 Chat** on Windows and choose a model folder, such as `Edge0-145B-q3k`, to run the model locally. To build the app from source, follow the [Edge0 Chat](edge0-infer/examples/desktop/README.md) guide.
## Usage & troubleshooting 145B / 120B · Memory options
Low RAM · SSD offload - **SSD mode:** `--mmap-experts` — read uncached experts from SSD on demand. - **Low-memory arguments:** ```bash --resident-budget-gib 20 --expert-profile expert-profile.bin ``` Up to **20 GiB** of host RAM for the expert cache; uncached experts are read from SSD on demand. Includes `--mmap-experts` and disjoint GPU/RAM caches automatically. **Required:** a static expert profile. Replace `expert-profile.bin` with your profile path.
RAM budget · what 20 GiB covers - **Expert cache:** `--resident-budget-gib 20` caps host-RAM expert caching at **20 GiB**, lowered further to fit available memory. - **Total RAM:** expert cache + other runtime allocations. This flag does **not** set a total-process RAM limit. - **Benchmark limit:** the 20 GiB total RAM test budget is a separate measurement condition.
GPU / RAM · avoid duplicate experts - **Enable:** `--resident-experts` or `--resident-budget-gib N`, with a static `--expert-profile`. - **Effect:** experts cached in VRAM need no duplicate RAM copy. Compatible with SSD loading. - **Default:** off, prioritizing speed. - **Automatically enabled:** `--mmap-experts`, `--resident-cpu-experts`, `--resident-pin`.
### Capacity controls · VRAM and host RAM These live in the pack's `model.json` (`args` for flags, `env` for environment variables), so a change there applies to every launch of the model. | Flag | Meaning | Default | |---|---|---| | `--vram-reserve-mib N` | VRAM left free for the desktop, the driver and other processes; the engine sizes its caches from what remains. | `700` | | `--expert-cache N\|auto` | Expert slots kept in VRAM. `auto` derives the count from the free VRAM after the fixed footprint (projections, MTP draft, verify buffers, D/U device buffers). | `0` | | `--kv-resident N` | KV cells kept in VRAM per QSA layer; the rest streams from pinned host RAM, which frees VRAM for experts. | `0` | | `--spec N` | The MTP drafter's verify window: tokens proposed per check. A bigger window needs bigger verify buffers (about 180 MiB at 4) and pays off when every window has a fixed per-layer cost. Without an MTP layer there is no speculation. | `4` | | `--resident-budget-gib N` | Cap on the host-RAM expert cache. It holds only the experts the VRAM cache does **not** hold, so the two sets are disjoint, and the value is clamped to the RAM available minus headroom. Needs a static `--expert-profile`. | `0` | | `--mmap-experts` | Read experts through the pack file on demand instead of pinning them, so nothing is resident in RAM. | off | ## Documentation **Latest release · 145B / 120B** - [Models, measurements and architecture](docs/models/edge0-145b.md) - [edge0-strata · build and launch contract](edge0-strata/EDGE0.md) - edge0-infer model guides: [145B](edge0-infer/docs/edge0-145b.md) / [120B](edge0-infer/docs/edge0-120b.md) **Framework** - [edge0-infer](edge0-infer/README.md) · command line, local server and chat applications - [Local server](edge0-infer/docs/local-server.md) / [Testing](edge0-infer/docs/testing.md) - [Model asset tools and adding a model](edge0-infer/tools/assets/README.md)
Previous release · models and native-engine documentation - [35B / 8B release guide](docs/legacy-models.md) - [MoE routing and experts](docs/moe.md) / [prerouter](docs/prerouter.md) - Model references: [edge0-35b](docs/models/edge0-35b.md) / [edge0-8b](docs/models/edge0-8b.md) - [Getting started](edge0-infer/docs/getting-started.md): native build, model assets, run, chat and serve across supported platforms - [Configuration](edge0-infer/docs/configuration.md) / [Native API](edge0-infer/docs/native-api.md) - [Architecture](edge0-infer/docs/architecture.md) / [Native-engine design](edge0-infer/docs/architecture.md#native-engine) / [Known limitations](edge0-infer/docs/limitations.md) - [Benchmarking](edge0-infer/docs/benchmarking.md) - Technical report: [The Other Half of the Memory Wall](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18063) ([PDF](paper/main.pdf))
## Roadmap
Q4 2026 · architecture and inference **Models & algorithms** Q4 works two fronts: bringing a next-generation architecture into the framework, and turning latent reasoning into a real latency saving rather than just an arithmetic one. - **Next-gen architecture support (Qwen3.8-Flash class)** — run hybrid linear attention (GDN + QSA), gated multi-branch residual, and N-gram embedding topologies on edge0. These designs suit SSD streaming offload naturally: O(1)-state attention keeps long thinking from becoming a KV-cache problem, and lookup-only N-gram tables stream on demand. Goal: the tier runs on a single device and benchmarks within an acceptable gap of the fp16 base. - **Latent thinking + batched expert pre-prediction** — make latent reasoning a *latency* saving, not only an arithmetic one. The core engineering problem: move expert routing from per-position to **once per block**, so one prediction covers every position and round of a block and **expert load volume decouples from the reasoning loop count** — plus cross-block prefetch that loads the next block's experts inside the current block's compute window. Progress is measured as **end-to-end thinking-phase time at matched accuracy** (never tokens/s). [Previous-release milestones and planned native-engine support](docs/legacy-models.md#roadmap).
## Contributing
Development workflow and checks Contributions are welcome — issues, PRs, benchmark reports and model ports all count. Building and testing are described in [Testing](edge0-infer/docs/testing.md); the checks that need no model assets: ```bash cd edge0-infer cmake --preset cpu && cmake --build --preset cpu ctest --preset cpu -L "L0|L1" ``` For changes under `edge0-infer/`, open issues and PRs in this repository as usual; the directory is developed in a separate repository, and an accepted change is applied there first by the maintainers and arrives here with the next sync. See [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md). Workflow: fork → feature branch → PR against `main`. Please keep the tests passing and add tests for new behavior.
## Citation The technical report covers 35B SSD streaming and trained routing prediction. If you find edge0 useful, please cite our technical report: ```bibtex @article{lin2026other, title = {The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction}, author = {Lin, Yu and Wang, Yiming and Cai, Runyuan and Liu, Hanze and Zeng, Xiaodong}, journal = {arXiv preprint arXiv:2609.18063}, year = {2026}, url = {https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18063} } ``` ## Contact Us - **Discord**: [edge0.ai/discord](https://edge0.ai/discord) — community chat and support - **Email**: samuel@edge0.ai For bugs and feature requests, please use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0/issues).

## 关于

Edge0 是一个开源流式 MoE 推理框架，用于在消费级硬件上运行大型稀疏模型。

可通过命令行、本地 API 服务或 Edge0 Chat 应用使用。 最新版本让 145B 和 120B 潜空间 MoE 模型能够在单张 NVIDIA GPU 上运行。 两款模型均采用原生 4 位训练，提供 Q3_K 和 NVFP4 格式，面向本地 agent 任务。 [`edge0-infer`](edge0-infer/README.md) 提供统一的 `serve` 和 `chat` 命令，并根据模型文件夹选择引擎。最新模型运行于 Strata 的分支 [edge0-strata](edge0-strata/EDGE0.md)；此前的 35B 版本使用[基于 GGML 的原生引擎](docs/legacy-models_zh.md#native-engine-design)。 ### 支持平台 平台支持取决于模型及其引擎。 | 平台 | `edge0-145b`, `edge0-120b` (edge0-strata) | `edge0-35b`（原生引擎） | | --- | --- | --- | | **Linux** | NVIDIA GPU (CUDA 13) | CPU | | **Windows** | NVIDIA GPU (CUDA 13) | CPU, Vulkan | | **macOS** (Apple Silicon) | — | Metal, CPU | | **iOS** | — | Metal | | **Android** | — | CPU | 最新版本请参阅 [145B / 120B 安装说明](#getting-started)。[此前版本指南](docs/legacy-models_zh.md#platforms)涵盖原生后端、各平台构建和聊天示例。8B 检查点已发布，原生引擎支持仍在计划中。 ## 模型

## 快速开始 ### 145B / 120B · edge0-strata 每个模型文件夹（Q3_K 或 NVFP4，Edge0-145B 或 Edge0-120B）均通过 `edge0-infer` 运行，可使用命令行或 Edge0 Chat 桌面应用。请保持文件夹原有结构：`edge0-infer` 根据 `model.json` 中的 `model_name` 识别模型。 145B 和 120B 使用 `serve` 或 `chat`；`run` 属于原生引擎。
平台与文档说明 构建说明适用于 Linux 或 Windows（x64 或 ARM64）上的 NVIDIA GPU 与 CUDA 13。Apple M2 Ultra 的测量使用 Metal，不代表已发布 macOS 支持。
构建与命令行说明 **1. 构建。** 克隆仓库，然后构建两个部分。以下启动命令均在 `edge0-infer/` 目录下执行： ```bash git clone https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0.git edge0 ``` - **edge0-strata** 引擎：参照 [edge0-strata/EDGE0.md](edge0-strata/EDGE0.md) 中的“Build (Linux, NVIDIA)”或“Build (Windows, NVIDIA)”。 - **edge0-infer**：参照 [edge0-infer/docs/getting-started.md](edge0-infer/docs/getting-started.md) 中的“Build”（Linux）或“Windows”。 **2. 从命令行运行。** 传入单个模型文件夹，例如 `Edge0-145B-q3k`，而非包含多个模型的上级目录。Windows 程序路径为 `build\windows\bin\edge0-infer.exe`。 ```bash build/cpu/bin/edge0-infer serve --model /path/to/Edge0-145B-q3k ``` 权重加载完成后会输出 `Listening: http://127.0.0.1:8000 model=`，其中 `` 为 `edge0_145b`，随后提供兼容 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的接口： ```bash curl localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"model":"edge0_145b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":64}' ``` `edge0-infer chat --model /path/to/Edge0-145B-q3k` 则启动交互会话。更多选项见 [edge0-infer/docs/edge0-145b.md](edge0-infer/docs/edge0-145b.md)。
桌面应用 · Windows ⬇️ **下载：** **[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0/releases)** 在 Windows 上打开 **Edge0 Chat**，选择模型文件夹（如 `Edge0-145B-q3k`）即可本地运行。如需从源码构建应用，请参阅 [Edge0 Chat](edge0-infer/examples/desktop/README.md) 指南。

## 路线图
2026 年第四季度 · 架构与推理 **模型与算法** 第四季度重点推进两条路线：将下一代架构接入框架，以及让潜空间推理真正降低延迟，而不只是减少计算量。 - **下一代架构支持（Qwen3.8-Flash 类）** — 在 edge0 上运行混合线性注意力（GDN + QSA）、门控多分支残差和 N-gram 嵌入拓扑。这些设计天然适合 SSD 流式卸载：O(1) 状态的注意力避免长思考演变为 KV-cache 容量问题，只需查表的 N-gram 表可按需流式加载。目标是在单台设备上运行，并将评测成绩与 fp16 基座的差距控制在可接受范围内。 - **潜空间思考 + 批量专家预预测** — 让潜空间推理节省的是*延迟*，而不仅是算术运算。核心工程问题是将专家路由从逐位置改为**每个块一次**，使一次预测覆盖块内所有位置和轮次，令**专家加载量与推理循环次数解耦**；同时跨块预取，在当前块的计算窗口内加载下一块的专家。进展以**相同准确率下的端到端思考阶段耗时**衡量，绝不以 tokens/s 衡量。 [此前版本里程碑与原生引擎支持计划](docs/legacy-models_zh.md#roadmap)。
